# Hostile argument vectors for scripts/recipes/web3js-history.sh. test-recipes.sh runs each one in its fixture
# repository (the working directory), which holds a.rs, programs/p/lib.rs and notes/, the run directory audit_1
# (rundir.sh new audit), audit_2 (a symbolic link to audit_1), link (a symbolic link to .) and notarun/, and
# whose config names a pager, an fsmonitor hook, an external diff and a textconv driver that each leave a
# marker file. One case per line: <exit status><TAB><the one stderr line><TAB><argument>[<TAB><argument>...].
# Each case prints nothing on stdout, starts none of those programs and changes nothing in the working
# directory.
64	web3js-history: refused: usage: web3js-history.sh [--repo <dir> | --git-dir <R>/src.git]	npm
64	web3js-history: refused: usage: web3js-history.sh [--repo <dir> | --git-dir <R>/src.git]	--all
64	web3js-history: refused: usage: web3js-history.sh [--repo <dir> | --git-dir <R>/src.git]	-p
64	web3js-history: refused: usage: web3js-history.sh [--repo <dir> | --git-dir <R>/src.git]	--output=x
64	web3js-history: refused: usage: web3js-history.sh [--repo <dir> | --git-dir <R>/src.git]	-c	core.pager=x
64	web3js-history: refused: usage: web3js-history.sh [--repo <dir> | --git-dir <R>/src.git]	--repo	.	extra
64	web3js-history: refused: usage: web3js-history.sh [--repo <dir> | --git-dir <R>/src.git]	--repo=.
64	web3js-history: refused: --repo needs a value	--repo
64	web3js-history: refused: --git-dir needs a value	--git-dir
64	web3js-history: refused: --repo is empty	--repo	
64	web3js-history: refused: --git-dir is empty	--git-dir	
64	web3js-history: refused: give --repo or --git-dir once	--repo	.	--repo	.
64	web3js-history: refused: give --repo or --git-dir once	--repo	.	--git-dir	audit_1/src.git
64	web3js-history: refused: --repo has an empty, . or .. component: ../x	--repo	../x
64	web3js-history: refused: --repo must be relative to the working directory: /etc	--repo	/etc
64	web3js-history: refused: --repo may not start with - or ~: ~	--repo	~
64	web3js-history: refused: --repo may not start with - or ~: -x	--repo	-x
64	web3js-history: refused: --repo passes through a symbolic link: link	--repo	link
64	web3js-history: refused: --repo is not the top level of its repository: programs	--repo	programs
64	web3js-history: refused: --repo is not the top level of its repository: notes	--repo	notes
64	web3js-history: refused: --repo is not an existing directory: missing	--repo	missing
64	web3js-history: refused: --repo is not an existing directory: a.rs	--repo	a.rs
64	web3js-history: refused: --repo has an empty, . or .. component: ./programs/../programs	--repo	./programs/../programs
64	web3js-history: refused: --repo is longer than 1024 bytes	--repo	
64	web3js-history: refused: --git-dir takes <R>/src.git or <R>/src-<k>.git: src.git	--git-dir	src.git
64	web3js-history: refused: --git-dir takes <R>/src.git or <R>/src-<k>.git: audit_1/other.git	--git-dir	audit_1/other.git
64	web3js-history: refused: --git-dir takes <R>/src.git or <R>/src-<k>.git: audit_1/src-x.git	--git-dir	audit_1/src-x.git
64	web3js-history: refused: --git-dir names no copy that git-ro.sh copy made: audit_1/src.git	--git-dir	audit_1/src.git
64	web3js-history: refused: --git-dir's run directory is not an existing directory: audit_9	--git-dir	audit_9/src.git
64	web3js-history: refused: --git-dir's run directory must be a run directory named audit_<n> or incident_<n> in the working directory: notarun	--git-dir	notarun/src.git
64	web3js-history: refused: --git-dir's run directory is a symbolic link: audit_2	--git-dir	audit_2/src.git
64	web3js-history: refused: --git-dir takes <R>/src.git or <R>/src-<k>.git: /abs/src.git	--git-dir	/abs/src.git
64	web3js-history: refused: --git-dir takes <R>/src.git or <R>/src-<k>.git: ../audit_1/src.git	--git-dir	../audit_1/src.git
64	web3js-history: refused: an argument holds a control character: x?[31m	x[31m
64	web3js-history: refused: an argument is longer than 4096 bytes	--repo
